title: Synthetic identity: disposable email, days-old account, address mismatch, human-paced session
narrative: An $899 electronics order from an account created less than a week ago with a disposable email address, an unverified phone and a billing address that fails verification, on a device never seen before. The browsing session itself looks human: several pages, a few minutes, no input anomalies.
rationale: Disposable email, a days-old account, unverified phone, failed address verification and a new device on a high-value electronics order are a synthetic or stolen identity; standard merchant policy is to decline. A human-paced session is what a careful fraudster produces and does not offset the identity evidence. The velocity view is not graded: it compares the amount to card history that a days-old account cannot have.
